definition.simple: How fast you can get work done. More power means doing the same job in less time.
definition.academic: The rate at which work is done, or energy is transferred, over time. The formula is P = W/t, measured in Watts (Joules per second).

examples: A high-power sports car accelerating faster than a normal car.
Running up stairs requires more power than walking up, even though the work done is the same.

common_misconceptions: Power and work are the same thing.
A strong person always generates more power (ignoring how long it takes them to apply the force).
ai_context.tutor_hint: If two people do the exact same task but one finishes twice as fast, ask who used more power.
